documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings, highlighting a consolidated revenue growth of approximately 39% and an EBITDA increase of 48%. Management noted that the primary growth driver was core product developments and high-value additions rather than forward integration or commodity pricing. The company is actively expanding its capabilities in specialized materials, components, and assemblies like busbars and PCBA, while working on reducing inventory cycles. Furthermore, management indicated that the domestic market is presenting strong growth opportunities alongside international customer relationships. Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited reported strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, characterized by double-digit revenue growth and margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth for FY27 to be in the range of 20% to 30%.
guidance.quote: Anyway, so… so growth, you know, we… if things go as per what we have in, in forecast, etc, or what expectations we have from the customers, we could… we could, on an overall revenue basis be looking at somewhere… somewhere between the, you know, that 20% to 30% kind of a number.

guidance.claim: For the standalone bimetal and shunt mix, management expects about 44-45% from bimetals and 54-55% from shunts.
guidance.quote: we expect, like, maybe a 44-45% revenue coming from Bimetal, and 54-55% coming from shunts.

guidance.claim: On a consolidated level, 30% to 35% of total revenue is expected to come from the contacts business.
guidance.quote: On a consolidated level, I think we would be more like, maybe around, you know, like a 30-35% of total consolidated revenue would be from, somewhere between the 30% to 35% should be from the contacts business, which is the wholly owned subsidiary.

guidance.claim: Management expects about 15-16% of total revenue in the first year to come from assemblies like PCB assemblies and bus bar assemblies.
guidance.quote: And, we expect that, from… from the… these assemblies, the PCB assemblies and these, bus bar assemblies, we expect, like, maybe a… about a… in the first year, maybe about a 15-16% of total revenue coming from that.

guidance.claim: Management estimates the potential revenue from the Pune facility to be in the range of 300 to 400 crores in about 3 years' time.
guidance.quote: expect the kind of business that we are looking at, or the value of that business that we can gain from this Pune facility for this particular thing, you know, somewhere in the range of 300 to 400 crores, and to in about 3 years' time

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects sustained demand for precision components in grid modernization, EVs, and storage systems due to the energy transition.
demand_outlook.quote: Electrification: Accelerated energy transition towards renewables is driving sustained demand for precision components in grid modernisation, EVs, and storage systems, strengthening medium-term visibility for Shunt Resistors and Bimetals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that the surge in data center build-out and AI-driven digitization is unlocking structural tailwinds for bimetals and shunt resistors.
demand_outlook.quote: Data Centres: Surge in global data centre build-out and AI-driven digitisation is catalysing demand in power infrastructure and grid equipment, unlocking structural tailwinds for both Bimetals (thermal protection) and Shunt Resistors (current sensing).

demand_outlook.claim: India delivered broad-based growth across both bimetal and shunt businesses.
demand_outlook.quote: India delivered broad-brace growth across both businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe grew strongly, led by shunts.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe grew strongly, led by shunts, with the Americas also showing early improvement in shunts with a 30% growth year-on-year this quarter, after a softer FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Asia was weaker during the quarter and remains an area focused on rebuilding momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: Asia was weaker during the quarter, and remains an area where we are focused on building rebuild… on rebuilding momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: Bimetal quantities are seeing an uptake, particularly in the domestic market, driven by real estate and infrastructure development.
demand_outlook.quote: For the first time in, actually, quite a few quarters now, like, 4 or 5 quarters, we are actually getting this kind of a feedback from the customers, wherein… and we are actually seeing it in this current quarter, that Bimetal is, for the first time, seeing an uptake in terms of not value or anything, but specifically in terms of quantities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the core focus moving forward will be in capacity enhancement on downstream processes.
capex_expansion.quote: So, you see the, core focus moving forward will be, A) in capacity enhancement on downstream processes, because as we've discussed in the past also, you know, the core, if you talk about the core product categories where it comes to the actual diffusion or the… or the merging of the metals, for either of the business verticals, that principal processes have sufficient capacity, but as and when required, depending on the demand from the market or the order book, there is enhancement that has to happen on the downstream processes, which is a fairly quick cycle to enhance.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is planning certain expansions and capex expenditure for PCB and PCBA type of parts.
capex_expansion.quote: Then, of course, for the PCB and PCB A type of parts, we are also planning certain expansions and CAPEX expenditure there as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is establishing a facility in Pune to strengthen its presence in PCBA and busbar assemblies.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our growth strategy, we are establishing our Pune facility to strengthen our presence in PCBA and busbar assemblies for automotive and electrification-led applications.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of obtaining approvals for Phase II of the Pune facility.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is in the process of obtaining the necessary approvals and permissions for setting up Phase II of the Pune facility

capex_expansion.claim: Subsequent to the quarter, the Pune facility received consent to operate for Phase 1.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequent to the quarter, receiving consent to operate for Phase 1 is an important milestone in the operationalization of our Pune facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The CAPEX requirement for the entire Pune project is in the ballpark of about 20 to 25 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the CAPEX requirement for this entire project is somewhere in the, you know, ballpark of about 20 to 25 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that any increase or decrease in raw material prices acts as a pass-through with minimal impact on the bottom line.
margins_costs.quote: first of all, our pricing works in such a way that we… in most cases, or a vast majority of materials are sort of a pass-through, so any increase or decrease has very minimal impact on our bottom line.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins expanded in Q2 FY27 due to a richer product mix and disciplined input cost management.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin expanded by 438 basis points to 54.20% in Q2 FY27, driven by a richer product mix and disciplined input cost management.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increased 35.2% to 43.2 crores, and PAT grew 44.9% to 33 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increased 35.2 to 43.2 crores, and PAT grew 44.9% to 33 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Sequentially, revenue increased 13%, EBITDA 23%, and PAT 26%.
margins_costs.quote: Sequentially, revenue increased 13%, EBITDA 23%, and PAT 26%, giving us a strong operating start to FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Margin improvement was achieved while employee costs increased due to investments in capacity, people, and capability.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, this margin improvement was achieved while employee costs increased as we invested in capacity, people, and capability, giving us confidence that the underlying operating model is strengthening as we scale.

margins_costs.claim: About half of the year-on-year revenue growth can be attributed to silver alone due to higher silver bullion prices.
margins_costs.quote: So I would say about what you purely see as revenue, about half of that revenue growth can be attributed to silver, silver, alone.

margins_costs.claim: Roughly 70-75% of the value-addition growth in shunts has come from converting to value-added parts rather than from materials.
margins_costs.quote: if we were to see that out of the overall growth, roughly about 70-75% of that value addition growth has come from, from converting to value-added parts rather than from the materials.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's existing asset base can support over ₹1,300 crore in revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: The existing asset base can support >₹ 1,300 Cr revenue, sustaining high incremental Pre-tax ROCE without major greenfield risk.

orders_capacity.claim: Shunts remained the stronger growth engine with revenue increasing 18.7%, while bimetals grew 7.4%.
orders_capacity.quote: From the quarter, Shunts remained the stronger growth engine, with revenue increasing 18.7%, but bimetals grew 7.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: The approved capacity of the Pune facility provides a scalable manufacturing platform for cell connecting systems.
orders_capacity.quote: The approved capacity provides a scalable manufacturing platform for cell connecting systems and support our strategy of increasing participation in value-added components and assemblies.

orders_capacity.claim: Welding capacity utilization for shunts is currently at about 65%-70%.
orders_capacity.quote: if we look at purely our welding capacity, right now we are at about 65%-70% of our welding capacity.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the inventory buildup is a temporary phenomenon driven by excess development work.
risks_headwinds.quote: Basically, Bhavya, this is more of a temporary phenomenon because of the excess development work that's going on.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced a decline in the Americas due to softer shunt offtake.
risks_headwinds.quote: Americas declined 24.3% in Q2 and 11.0% in H1 on softer Shunt offtake.

risks_headwinds.claim: Asia was weaker during the quarter and remains an area requiring focus on rebuilding momentum.
risks_headwinds.quote: Asia was weaker during the quarter, and remains an area where we are focused on building rebuild… on rebuilding momentum.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that a new CFO is finalized and should be with the company by the end of December.
management_commitments.quote: to begin with, in the leadership role, a new CFO should be, with us, and, you know, it's all finalized, should be with us, and, by the end of December.

management_commitments.claim: Full production of cell connecting systems and bus bars has started, and a lot of production is going to start reflecting in the current quarter and upcoming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: full production has started, and a lot of that production has not been a part of this Q1. So it's more of it is… there has been some revenue addition in this one month or so of the last month of the quarter, but most of it is going to start reflecting in the current quarter and the upcoming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The main manufacturing facility for cell connecting systems will become fully operational in October.
management_commitments.quote: because our real manufacturing, the main manufacturing facility for this actually becomes fully operational only in October.

management_commitments.claim: The next phase of the Pune facility will focus on completing customer and process qualifications, establishing repeatable production systems, and scaling in line with program requirements.
management_commitments.quote: The next phase will focus on completing customer and process qualifications, establishing repeatable production systems, and scaling in line with program requirements.

management_commitments.claim: Export bimetal volume developments with existing customers are expected to add revenue over a slightly longer term like 4 quarters or so, or a year from now.
management_commitments.quote: those, of course, are not something that we foresee are going to add a lot of revenue in the coming, say, one or two quarters, but let's say slightly longer term, like 4 quarters or so, or a year from now, we should see added revenue coming from those developments as well.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to have more concrete information to share regarding the specialized electronics material partnership by the next earnings call.
management_commitments.quote: and hopefully, you know, by the time we have our next earnings call, we should have a lot more concrete information to share on that development.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
